subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined words in the given sentence.

Rare species __of frogs were very quicker__ identified by Stella.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"quicker"** means at a faster rate or speed than usual. (तेज़)

 
 
• **Example:** He ran** quicker** than all the other contestants.
 
 
 
• **"Quickly"** refers to something happening with speed or promptness. (शीघ्रता से)
 
 
• **Example:** She **quickly **finished her homework.
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct word to replace **"very quicker" **is **"very quickly"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: to frogs were very quickly** (मेंढक बहुत जल्दी थे): This does not fit grammatically in the sentence.

 
 
• **Example:** Incorrect usage: Rare species to frogs were very quickly identified by Stella.
 
 
 
• **Option 3: in frogs were very quicker** (में मेंढक बहुत तेज थे): This is grammatically incorrect and does not fit the context.
 
 
• **Example:** Incorrect usage: Rare species in frogs were very quicker identified by Stella.
 
 
 
• **Option 4: of frogs were very quicklier** (मेंढकों के बहुत तेजी से थे): "Quicklier" is not a correct word in English.
 
 
• **Example:** Incorrect usage: Rare species of frogs were very quicklier identified by Stella.
 
 

3e:Tc80,

The correct answer is: **Option 2.**
